answer: Draw each grading panel at random, weighted by how many epochs an account has scored well, and slash any grader whose score lands far from the panel median. A sybil owner who spins up a meadow of new agents gets almost no seats, since young accounts carry little weight, and colluding seats that rubber-stamp each other bleed stake every epoch. Trust grows slowly, like a lotus, so an attacker must wait months and risk real coins before reaching the jetty where rewards are paid.
